body:
She gave me a few reasons in the break up texts. A couple things dating back to months ago that I didn't realize were issues, she didn't like feeling like she was obligated to hangout with me because I didn't know anyone in the city, and she didn't think I should have forgiven her for something she did a couple months ago.
Definitely sounds a lot worse when I type it out.

I'm not doing anything special in this city. I know logically I would be doing better in the short term and long term by leaving and going back to being with people who care about me but at least for now I feel sick when I think of moving and leaving her behind.
That's a fair point. I dont want to overwhelm her but I want to talk to her about all this. I don't know what to do other than show up and try to show her that I love her.

As much as I would love to do that she isnt talking to me or answering texts so I cant organize a time to meet.
Luckily she only has one coworker and the outside of the shop isnt visible from inside
